title: Package managers side by side
summary: The same jobs in apt, dnf, zypper, pacman and apk.

steps.title: Two layers
body: Every family has a **low-level** tool that installs a single package file, and a **high-level** tool that talks to repositories and resolves dependencies:
| Family | Low level (one file) | High level (repos + dependencies) |
| RHEL / Fedora | `rpm` (`.rpm`) | `dnf` (older: `yum`; RHEL 8+ `yum` is an alias for dnf) |
You almost always use the high-level tool. `dpkg -i` / `rpm -i` on a downloaded file do **not** fetch its dependencies; `apt install ./file.deb` and `dnf install ./file.rpm` do.

steps.prompt: Match the low-level tool to its high-level partner.

steps.title: The equivalence table
body: | Job | apt | dnf | zypper | pacman | apk |
| refresh the index | `apt update` | `dnf check-update` (or `makecache`) | `zypper refresh` | `pacman -Sy` | `apk update` |
| upgrade everything | `apt upgrade` | `dnf upgrade` | `zypper update` | `pacman -Syu` | `apk upgrade` |
| install | `apt install x` | `dnf install x` | `zypper install x` | `pacman -S x` | `apk add x` |
| remove | `apt remove x` | `dnf remove x` | `zypper remove x` | `pacman -R x` | `apk del x` |
| search | `apt search x` | `dnf search x` | `zypper search x` | `pacman -Ss x` | `apk search x` |
| details | `apt show x` | `dnf info x` | `zypper info x` | `pacman -Si x` | `apk info x` |

On Arch never run `pacman -Sy x` alone (a partial upgrade can break libraries): install with `pacman -S x` after a full `pacman -Syu`. In Dockerfiles: `apt-get update && apt-get install -y x`, `dnf install -y x`, `apk add --no-cache x`.

steps.title: Translate an apt command
prompt: Write `string Translate(string command, string target)` turning an apt command into the equivalent for `target` (`"dnf"`, `"pacman"`, `"apk"` or `"zypper"`), using the table above:
- the command may start with `sudo` (keep it), and may use `apt` or `apt-get`,
- verbs: `update`, `upgrade`, `install`, `remove`, `search`, `show`; any package arguments are kept in order,
- anything else (an unknown verb, target or tool) → `"unsupported"`.
`Translate("sudo apt install curl git", "apk")` returns `sudo apk add curl git`.
solution: var table = new Dictionary<string, Dictionary<string, string>>
["dnf"] = new() { ["update"] = "dnf check-update", ["upgrade"] = "dnf upgrade", ["install"] = "dnf install", ["remove"] = "dnf remove", ["search"] = "dnf search", ["show"] = "dnf info" },
["apk"] = new() { ["update"] = "apk update", ["upgrade"] = "apk upgrade", ["install"] = "apk add", ["remove"] = "apk del", ["search"] = "apk search", ["show"] = "apk info" },

["zypper"] = new() { ["update"] = "zypper refresh", ["upgrade"] = "zypper update", ["install"] = "zypper install", ["remove"] = "zypper remove", ["search"] = "zypper search", ["show"] = "zypper info" },
if (!table.TryGetValue(target, out var verbs) || !verbs.TryGetValue(verb, out var result)) return "unsupported";
hints: Split on spaces with `RemoveEmptyEntries`; peel off `sudo`, then the tool, then the verb.
A nested dictionary `target → verb → command` keeps it tidy.
template: Dojo.Eq("install on apk", "sudo apk add curl git", Translate("sudo apt install curl git", "apk"));
Dojo.Eq("remove on pacman", "pacman -R nano", Translate("apt remove nano", "pacman"));
Dojo.Eq("update on dnf", "sudo dnf check-update", Translate("sudo apt-get update", "dnf"));
Dojo.Eq("show on zypper", "zypper info htop", Translate("apt show htop", "zypper"));
Dojo.Eq("search on apk", "apk search nginx", Translate("  apt   search   nginx ", "apk"));

steps.title: Mission: packages and services
prompt: No internet, two `.deb` files and a dependency puzzle. In **Packages and services**, do **Install, offline** with `dpkg` and the dependency order it needs.
steps.explain: `dpkg -i` installs one file and complains about missing dependencies; installing them first (or `apt install ./file.deb`) solves the puzzle.
